name: GET_DETAILS / locId
summary: A pair of Google Apps Script custom functions that make the Google Places API callable straight from spreadsheet cells: locId(text) resolves free text to a place id, and GET_DETAILS(id) spills that place's name, coordinates, address, phone, rating, price level and opening hours across a row.
details: The recall value is the technique, not the code: a custom function returning a nested array ([[a, b, c]]) is how one Apps Script call fills several cells at once, which is what makes the two-step locId -> GET_DETAILS chain usable as a plain formula pair in adjacent columns. Both functions inline an API_KEY constant, placeholdered here as YOUR_PLACES_API_KEY, so no real key is in the repository. Neither function handles an error response, a zero-candidate result (locId indexes candidates[0] unconditionally) or Apps Script's per-execution quota; GET_DETAILS only short-circuits on an empty id. place.opening_hours is emitted as a raw object, so that cell renders as [object Object] rather than usable hours. The endpoints are the legacy Places API (maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/...), which Google has since superseded with Places API (New).

source.note: locId is defined immediately below it in the same file.
